response.overview: During an ordinary bike ride, a man discovers a mysterious amulet in a wash and gains supernatural abilities. When two identical, otherworldly beings begin pursuing him, his discovery spirals into a surreal, action-driven encounter that blurs the line between humanity and divinity. Created as a visual companion to Jay Kasai’s album of the same name, God’s Complex.
response.tagline: Is a god born, or created
response.title: God's Complex
